description: The Seychelles Ministry of Health publishes two annual statistical reports that together describe almost all public health service activity in the island state. The 2025 hospital services report, 38 pages long, covers accident and emergency consultations by day, hour and age group, ambulance dispatches and the reasons for calls, laboratory tests, chemotherapy, and bed nights, admissions, deaths, occupancy, length of stay and throughput for Seychelles Hospital, the hospice and North East Point Hospital, with some series running from 2020. The 2025 primary healthcare report, 55 pages long, counts doctor consultations and nursing visits, dressings and home visits by health centre since 2016, maternal and child health attendances, school health sessions, immunisation and family planning. Both are free to download as PDFs from the ministry website. Caveats: the tables are in PDFs, only the 2025 editions were located, and no licence is stated. Coverage is national for public services. Simulation uses: demand and capacity figures for hospital, emergency department and ambulance models in a small island state, and surge planning for storms and outbreaks. Related records: the Bermuda Hospitals Board statistics (data-bermuda-hospitals-board-statistics) give comparable small-island hospital activity data.

schema_summary: Hospital report (38 pages): A&E consultations by day of week and time and by age group; ambulance dispatches by sex and age and reasons for calls; laboratory tests 2021-2025; chemotherapy; bed nights, admissions and deaths for Seychelles Hospital 2023-2025; total admissions and average occupancy 2020-2025; occupancy, average length of stay and throughput; similar tables for the hospice and North East Point Hospital. Primary care report (55 pages): doctor consultations and nursing visits, dressings and domiciliary visits by health centre 2016-2025, antenatal, postnatal and MCH attendances, school health, immunisation doses and coverage, family planning, and new attendances by diagnosis
